decision: Use explicit terminal states, fake-clock retry deadlines and immutable schedule identity.

R-scheduled-delivery.text: Schedule a stable ID, due tick and payload. run(now, effect) processes due pending/retry jobs at most once per call. Three total attempts maximum, retries at now+2 ticks. Cancel pending/retry only; done/cancelled/failed stay terminal. Repeated schedule with same ID and payload/due is idempotent, conflicting payload/due raises ValueError.

I-scheduled-delivery.text: Synthetic cancellation request returned success but a cancelled parcel was still dispatched. A retry workaround rewrote completed jobs as cancelled on late requests.

L-scheduled-delivery.text: Synthetic cancellation request returned success but a cancelled parcel was still dispatched. A retry workaround rewrote completed jobs as cancelled on late requests.

T-scheduled-delivery.text: pending -> cancelled | done | retry; retry -> cancelled | done | failed. completed effects never repeat; failed is terminal after attempt three.
